title: Injective fixed raw scalar comparison
statement: For every commutative ring Λ, k:W→S, module sheaf G on W, q∈ℕ, U∈S.Etale and A∈Over(W), the underlying additive map of rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A [def-sbc-raw-module-abelian-hom-map] is injective.

proof.text: Put V=forget Λ A.left, F=A.hom^*G, L=(A.hom≫k)^*Λ[U], B=(A.hom≫k)^*Z[U] and a=f^*(freeMap)≫pullback. The underived free-source theorem gives bijective Hom comparison on every injective. The proved source-acyclicity theorem gives rightAcyclic for Hom(B,-). Apply the general resolution comparison to F in degree q.

The coefficient comparison b is a composite of the shift comparison, shifted single comparison, and shifted single map of the inverse pullback isomorphism; hence it is invertible. Unfold the bundled raw map to c≫(D+(V)(x)≫b). Apply the injectivity just obtained and cancel the monomorphism b. Associativity identifies the two composites, proving equality of the original classes.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03FD and Tag 015E; explicit source-Hom/acyclic-resolution reduction, followed by coefficient-isomorphism cancellation

mathlib_searches.query: Injectivity and surjectivity of the derived section comparison from module sheaves to abelian sheaves
Forgetting scalars induces bijection on derived Hom from a free represented module sheaf to a shifted sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Free represented sections equivalences only; no explicit raw scalar map comparison
extAddEquivCohomologyClass exists for injective resolutions, but no scalar comparison
Mathlib bijectivity requires a fully faithful functor preserving injectives; no match for scalar forgetting. No duplicate raw-map clauses in the library/DAG.

from.place: Explicit raw scalar comparison: injective part of componentwise invertibility

theorem rawModuleAbelianHomMap_injective
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ)
    (U : S.Etale) (A : Over W) :
    Function.Injective (rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A).hom
